rule_name: operational safety for shelters, helplines, and survivor offices
trigger_subjects: shelter, helpline, survivor office, crisis support, public contact, operational route
candidate_sensitivity_signals: operational_safety|survivor_service|contact_path_near
required_boundary_action: Do not publish live intake, hotline, route, location, hours, capacity, or referral claims; keep public shape as boundary context only.

trigger_subjects: capacity, beds, open, accepting, current status, availability
candidate_sensitivity_signals: capacity_state|live_referral_safe=false
required_boundary_action: Separate historic/public institution shape from current availability; mark current capacity unverified or forbidden for public use.

trigger_subjects: reconciliation, family reunification, reunification law, return to family, coercive mediation
candidate_sensitivity_signals: family_or_survivor_autonomy|anti_coercion
required_boundary_action: Do not frame mercy as coerced reconciliation; require refusal/exit path and survivor/recipient autonomy language.

trigger_subjects: claim, source, capacity, narrative, interpretation, public prose
candidate_sensitivity_signals: evidence_role_separation|interpretive_claim

trigger_subjects: candidate identity, alias, path, ledger id, public label, file name

rule_name: posthumous / child / unclaimed remains consent boundary

candidate_sensitivity_signals: death_or_memorial|child_or_youth_vulnerability|family_led_boundary
required_boundary_action: Do not expand names, case details, images, or kin narratives without family/community authority; prefer office-shape language.

rule_name: public cemetery / searchable memorial database boundary

trigger_subjects: street medicine, outreach, encampment, mobile clinic, unsheltered route
